name: RIVR
def: A wheel legged delivery quadruped that stands upright to hand over parcels; trained end to end in simulation.
body: RIVR, formerly Swiss-Mile, put wheels on ANYmal lineage legs and trained the result end to end in simulation; it delivers parcels door to door in Zürich pilots, standing upright to ring the bell.

refs.label: The Robot Report, Swiss-Mile rebrands to RIVR
